limitations: This is a clean source/dependency test on the same machine, not an independent computer installation.
No model bytes, prior node_modules, private vaults or sibling-repository files were copied into the archive.
No real GPU job was run in this check; existing real evidence was validated.
Android SDK and JDK provisioning/native build were not repeated in this archive.
Later mobile linkage and receipt guard at e8e8515 have separate current-worktree TypeScript and local native build evidence.
